description_en: Removes device ownership identifiers for the current tenant in batches by record ID. You can obtain the IDs from the responses of the query and batch add operations. If any ID does not exist or does not belong to the current tenant, the entire batch fails and an InvalidParameter error is returned. After the identifiers are removed, device ownership is still determined by other matching items and explicit ownership configurations
description_zh: 按记录 ID 批量移除当前租户的设备归属标识。ID 可从查询和批量添加接口的响应获取。任一 ID 不存在或不属于当前租户时，整批失败，返回 InvalidParameter。移除标识后，设备归属仍由其他匹配项及显式归属配置共同决定
name: RemoveDeviceBelongIdentifiers

parameters.help_en: The list of identifier record IDs to remove. You can specify 1 to 1,000 IDs per batch. All IDs must exist and belong to the current tenant. Otherwise, an InvalidParameter error is returned and no records are deleted
parameters.help_zh: 待移除的标识记录 ID 列表，每批 1 至 1000 个。所有 ID 必须存在且属于当前租户，否则返回 InvalidParameter，且不删除任何记录
parameters.name: identifier_ids

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate the call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，可用于定位该次调用
